Trump’s huge Venezuela deal began with a call and a bet on an oilman

Alejandro Betancourt was warned that taking on the U.S. government as a business partner would have costs, but America’s backing already is providing benefits.

7 minutes ago
13 min
13 min
By Anthony Faiola
, 
Samantha Schmidt
and 
Karen DeYoung

On a phone call in March, a Trump administration emissary made a bold pitch. How would Alejandro Betancourt, a wealthy Venezuelan oilman and influential power player in his country, feel about taking on a new business partner: the U.S. government?
